home.hero_title: Focused tools. One problem at a time.
home.hero_lede: Acorn Juice Solutions is a two-person studio based in Navarra, Spain. We build small, sharp software — desktop apps, mobile widgets, and one-shot utilities — that solve a real problem for real people.
home.products_lede: A mix of commercial products and free utilities. Carefully maintained and monitored.
home.makers_lede: Every product gets personal attention and reflects the work of the team behind it.
home.approach_lede: Every product and every engagement — commercial or not — follows the same three principles.

approach.craft_body: Code review, testing gates, documented conventions and CI that fails loud. Nothing ships that we would not be comfortable handing off to a senior partner.
approach.patterns_body: Design patterns and architectural choices with a track record. We reach for the well-understood solution first, and only consider the clever one when it truly fits.
approach.security_body: Input validation at trust boundaries, secrets kept out of the repo, principle of least privilege, auditable dependencies. Built in from the first commit, not bolted on before release.

home.services_lede: Beyond our own products, we also work with teams as an extension of theirs. A short, honest list of what we can take on:

services.cloud_body: From on-prem or legacy environments to well-architected cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS or Google Cloud. Migration planning, cost modelling, and hands-on execution.
services.pipelines_body: Analysis and definition of build, test and release pipelines applying modern best practices — reproducible builds, gated releases, secret hygiene and rollout safety by default.
services.fullstack_body: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Angular. Backend services, APIs, front-ends and the database work that ties them together. Comfortable across stacks and legacy code.
services.infra_body: DevOps automation, environment provisioning, monitoring and networking — including Mikrotik router configuration for on-prem or hybrid setups.

home.contact_lede: Have a question, an idea, or a project you want us to look at? Drop us a line.
